description: Eval policy for asymmetric developed vs aborted seed prevalence on sunflower-cvat-2500. Manuscript headline metrics use the frozen test split only; val is for threshold tuning.

prevalence.summary: Developed seeds (class 0) outnumber aborted seeds (class 1) by roughly 10 percentage points (~55% / ~45% of boxes). This reflects biological head composition, not a deliberate class-balancing protocol.

split_drift_acceptance.note: Class prevalence is stable train→test (L1 ≈ 0.006); val↔test slightly noisier at n=109 but same order of magnitude.

eval_policy.split_role: held-out manuscript split; Ultralytics early-stop uses val.txt only

metrics.threshold_protocol: val sweep → lock global conf → test error_analysis (--locked-conf-from); no per-class conf in manuscript HSP sweep

optional_supplementary.purpose: Optional image list for high-aborted-fraction or ambiguous cases (MS uncertainty / integration tests); not used for primary test MAE.
